_readme: A query is one saved search: a listing URL plus the context needed to
score what comes back. The registry says which sites exist; a query says
which search on that site to run.
Run some:  python3 tools/jobfinder.py crawl --query energy --query early-career
Add one by copying a block. 'country' and 'language' are what the postings
inherit when the page itself does not say; 'sector' feeds the employer
